title: Rotting Oranges
contract: Grid values: 0 empty, 1 fresh, 2 rotten. Every minute rot spreads to four-directional fresh neighbors. Return minutes until no fresh oranges remain, or −1.
brute: int minutes=0;while(true){List<int[]> change=new ArrayList<>();int fresh=0;for(int r=0;r<grid.length;r++)for(int c=0;c<grid[0].length;c++)if(grid[r][c]==1){fresh++;for(int[] d:DIRS){int nr=r+d[0],nc=c+d[1];if(nr>=0&&nr<grid.length&&nc>=0&&nc<grid[0].length&&grid[nr][nc]==2){change.add(new int[]{r,c});break;}}}if(fresh==0)return minutes;if(change.isEmpty())return -1;for(int[] cell:change)grid[cell[0]][cell[1]]=2;minutes++;emit("Apply all changes simultaneously after scanning","minute",minutes,"grid",grid);}
optimal: Deque<int[]> q=new ArrayDeque<>();int fresh=0;for(int r=0;r<grid.length;r++)for(int c=0;c<grid[0].length;c++){if(grid[r][c]==2)q.add(new int[]{r,c});else if(grid[r][c]==1)fresh++;}int minutes=0;while(fresh>0&&!q.isEmpty()){int size=q.size();for(int i=0;i<size;i++){int[] cell=q.remove();for(int[] d:DIRS){int r=cell[0]+d[0],c=cell[1]+d[1];if(r>=0&&r<grid.length&&c>=0&&c<grid[0].length&&grid[r][c]==1){grid[r][c]=2;fresh--;q.add(new int[]{r,c});}}}minutes++;emit("Expand all sources one layer","minute",minutes,"fresh",fresh,"grid",grid);}return fresh==0?minutes:-1;
reasoning: Repeated whole-grid scans simulate simultaneous time steps, collecting changes before applying them.
Multi-source BFS starts all rotten cells together and visits each newly rotten cell once.
Process exactly the current queue size per minute. Empty cells block spread, and fresh cells left after the frontier empties are unreachable.
